newsitem.title: USA: Goodrich Petroleum tests Louisiana well.
newsitem.headline: Goodrich Petroleum tests Louisiana well.

text.p: Goodrich Petroleum Corp said Friday the Youngblood No. 1 well at Ada Field in Bienville Parish, La., flowed 7.0 million cubic feet of natural gas and 14 barrels of condensate daily from two zones on a flow test.
The well is awaiting pipeline connection and anticipates turning to sales within a week, the company said.
Goodrich Petroleum is the operator and holds about a 40 percent working interest in the well.
The company said it plans to drill an additional development well in Ada Field during the first quarter of 1997.
